name: evt_newlist
description: Short newly listed USDT-M perps that reach the PIT top-60 within weeks of launch, from d0 days after the first bar for H days, per-name protective stop, small inverse-vol size.
mechanism: Launch hype decay, supply unlocks / airdrop selling and market-maker inventory release make new tokens underperform for 1-3 months; the perp lets the late crowd be faded while shorts usually receive funding.
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

null.kind: random_coin = same OOS entry bars/side/size/stop/time stop on a random coin from mod.null_pool (see module docstring); sign_flip = each OOS event's side flipped with p=1/2. Re-simulated with costs.

implementability_200.note: run_events(round_to_qty=True, instruments=Bybit snapshot) on the stitched OOS entries. Symbols missing from the Bybit snapshot (mostly delisted) are NOT rounded/dropped. bybit_listed_at_entry_share = share of OOS entries whose symbol is in today's Bybit list with launchTime <= the decision close (lower bound on historical availability).

expectancy_units: mean return on entry notional per closed OOS trade, net of fees+slippage+funding (USD in trade_stats_oos)

causality.method: wf._guard_causal on the dev panel (entries identical on 6 random cuts)

correlation_to.basis: Pearson of daily returns: FROZEN dev-period run vs the other modules' frozen_dev_daily, and BTC close-to-close

btc_hedge_overlay_oos.note: approximation: hedge sized on the event book equity, simulated as a separate BTC sub-account

btc_hedge_overlay_frozen_dev.note: approximation: hedge sized on the event book equity, simulated as a separate BTC sub-account

oos_scaled_to_20pct_vol.note: linear scaling of the realised OOS book (sizes fixed a priori gave a lower vol than the 20% target); drawdown scales ~linearly too

verdict_rule:
Family-E rule, applied to the event nulls:
      p_used = the LARGER p of the random_coin and sign_flip nulls.
      promising: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, p_used <= 0.05, DSR (grid trials) >= 0.9, >= 60% OOS years positive,
                 >= min_events OOS events.
      marginal : OOS Sharpe >= 0.5 and p_used <= 0.10.   fails: otherwise.
      Fragility downgrade (one level): a +/-1 neighbour with negative dev Sharpe, or 2x-fee dev Sharpe < 0.25.
      Fewer than min_events OOS events caps the verdict at marginal.
caveats: Universe = coins that EVER reached the PIT top-60 (download union). Entries require PIT top-60 membership at the decision bar, so the tradable set is point-in-time complete; listings that never reached the top-60 are simply never traded (by construction, not by hindsight).
Bybit availability at entry time is not known historically (instrument snapshot is current, delisted names missing); see implementability_200.bybit_listed_at_entry_share.

screen.best: d0=14 H=30 stop=0.40: n=91, +12.9%/event net, t=3.4, hit 67% (but 2020 cohort dominated: 70 of 91)

post_hoc_diagnostics.WARNING: computed AFTER the walk-forward on the same OOS entries; explanatory only, not selection evidence (script _evt_screens/diag_newlist.py)
post_hoc_diagnostics.reading: The fade is right about the MEDIAN (new listings lose ~32% in 60d, 84% lag BTC) but the path is hostile: 54% rally >= 25% before bleeding, so a protective stop is hit on ~57% of shorts, and without a stop the squeeze tails liquidate the book. With stops the payoff becomes convex in either direction, which is why the sign-flip null (median 0.75) is not beaten. The BTC-hedged overlay's 1.19 is mostly generic 'short alts / long BTC' drift in 2022-25: shorting random mature top-60 coins at the same bars with the same hedge gives a null median of 1.07 (p=0.39).
